# iaas_lb_waf_rule (Resource)

Manages a custom WAF rule of a load balancer. The rule is a child of a load balancer, so load_balancer_id is part of the API path and changing it forces a new resource. Custom rule ids must be in 190000-199999 (the API rejects out-of-range ids). A rule is authored either directly (raw_seclang) or via the guided target/operator/match_value/action fields, which render into seclang server-side when raw_seclang is omitted. Import with a 2-part composite id: "<load_balancer_id>/<rule_uuid>".



<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `load_balancer_id` (String) UUID of the parent load balancer. Part of the API path; changing it forces a new resource.
- `name` (String) Human-readable rule name.

### Optional

- `action` (String) deny, log, pass or drop (default deny).
- `enabled` (Boolean) Whether the rule is active (default true).
- `match_value` (String) Guided-builder match value.
- `operator` (String) Guided-builder SecLang operator token (e.g. @rx). Used to render seclang when raw_seclang is omitted.
- `priority` (Number) Evaluation priority; maps to the real sort_order column.
- `raw_seclang` (String) Raw SecLang directive (advanced). Any embedded id: must be 190000-199999. Takes precedence over the guided fields below.
- `rule_id` (Number) SecLang rule id, must be 190000-199999. Auto-assigned in range if omitted (or extracted from an id: token in raw_seclang).
- `target` (String) Guided-builder SecLang variable (e.g. ARGS). Used to render seclang when raw_seclang is omitted.

### Read-Only

- `id` (String) UUID of the rule, assigned by the API.
- `seclang` (String) The rendered/stored SecLang directive, as returned by the API.
